description: This script performs HTTP endpoint health checks for the core BankApp endpoints, verifying responses for health, documentation, UI, and database console.

methods.name: log_pass
methods.description: Logs a passing check and increments the PASS counter.

methods.name: log_fail
methods.description: Logs a failing check and increments the FAIL counter.

methods.name: log_skip
methods.description: Logs a skipped check and increments the SKIP counter.

methods.name: do_request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request using curl, captures status code and response body.

methods.name: check_healthz
methods.description: Checks the /healthz endpoint for a 200 response with expected JSON body.

methods.name: check_actuator_health
methods.description: Checks the /actuator/health endpoint for proper JSON status.

methods.name: check_openapi_docs
methods.description: Checks the /v3/api-docs endpoint for openapi or swagger fields, indicating API documentation format.

methods.name: check_swagger_ui
methods.description: Verifies accessibility of the Swagger UI HTML at /swagger-ui.html.

methods.name: check_h2_console
methods.description: Verifies accessibility of the H2 console at /h2-console.
